test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 08
subject: general
question:
Which of the following is not a part of the main topographic regions of Nepal?

A. lowland

B. Hills

C. Deccan

D. Mountains
solution:
__**Deccan**__ is NOT correct.

 
• **Nepal **is a landlocked country in Asia.
 
• Nepal falls in the temperate zone north of the **Tropic of Cancer.**
 
• Nepal is divided into three geographical regions namely:
 
 
• **Himalayan region.**
 
• **Mid hill region.**
